description.value: To Live For is a fully plant-based bakery and café in East Vancouver, founded by broadcaster-turned-baker Erin Ireland after a personal vegan journey transformed the former 'To Die For Fine Foods' brand. The bakery turns out fresh pastries daily—including rotating monthly specials—and operates a wholesale delivery business supplying cafes and grocers across the Lower Mainland. A touring cyclist who eats vegan will find a rare dedicated all-vegan stop with both in-person and online ordering options.

raw_osm.description: Café & bakery serving 100% dairy and egg free vegan food.
raw_osm.name: To Live For

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at tolivefor.ca is active (copyright 2026) and confirms a 100% plant-based bakery and café at 1508 Nanaimo St, East Vancouver, fully consistent with OSM tags including diet:vegan=only and the OSM description. Online ordering with pickup and DoorDash delivery confirm takeout capability; the 'Unbelievably Vegan Baked Goods' messaging and OSM diet:vegan=only jointly confirm the vegan amenity. No bike parking, washroom, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging information appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those fields are null.
concerns: OSM name is 'To Live For' but the website consistently uses 'To Live For Bakery' as the trading name — minor discrepancy, OSM name retained per rules.
Phone number (+1 604-690-2720) from OSM could not be verified from website content; the contact page only provides a web form with no number listed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible vegan bakery and café with a current website and confirmed East Vancouver address — a useful stop for any touring cyclist, especially those eating plant-based.
enrichment_extras.notes: The business was formerly called 'To Die For Fine Foods' before rebranding to 'To Live For' following a full switch to vegan recipes. Catering and wholesale delivery services are available across the Lower Mainland.
